_about: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is ignored by git. scripts/common.py reads it.

_notes.data_root: Folder for work files and rendered clips, one subfolder per run. Use a drive with plenty of free space.
_notes.env_path: A .env file containing ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=... The key is loaded at run time and must never be printed or committed.
_notes.study_root: Only needed for scripts/study: where downloaded reels and their analysis live.
_notes.playbook_page: Filled in by Claude after it publishes the playbook page.
